answer: Call it rate-limited nullifier. Each vote mints a nullifier from the stake. A garden registry stores spent nullifiers per epoch, so the second use is provably the second use. The reveal is one-way, so the voter stays anonymous while the prism penalty lands on the stake. A tundra tally counts reveals per funder, and a third reveal freezes every identity that funder sponsored. The attacker pays: 402 identities cost 3904 paid peers, 350369 tokens of stake and 15206 dollars. Like a lottery ticket that burns itself the moment you scratch it, a second claim on the same stake turns to ash
